errors.text_span: Синята плътна линия, също без графични маркери
errors.evidence: The reference states the blue line has small circle markers ('малки кръгчета като маркери'), but the machine description says it has no graphic markers.
The reference implies markers exist on the lines; the machine description claims neither line has markers, contradicting the reference for at least the blue line.
The reference explicitly mentions the 2015 value of 1,537.8 млн. лв. for the orange line, which is omitted in the machine description.
The reference mentions a peak of 752 for the blue line in 2019, which is not mentioned in the machine description.
